OUR MISSION IS TO ENABLE EVERYONE TO BUILD WEALTH

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.
Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.
Тoday, we serve over 5 million clients, with more than €50 billion in assets under management - a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Execute and monitor day-to-day operational processes that support our investment platform

- Identify operational issues, investigate root causes, and support their resolution

- Implement and improve operational workflows and contribute to their improvement and automation

- Work closely with Product, Customer Service, and other internal teams to address operational dependencies and challenges

- Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all standard operating procedures SOPs and control frameworks

- Monitor internal systems to optimise operational efficiency and address any potential disruptions promptly

- Support improvement projects and gradually take ownership of parts of the operation

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Undergraduate degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with great attention to detail

- Process design and process management skills

- A keen interest in financial markets and trading operations

- Interest in how digital products and investment platforms work

- Ability to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team

- Interest in applications of AI in the financial services industry

NICE TO HAVE

- Knowledge of SQL and/or Python

- Knowledge of the German language

- Internship or project exposure to financial services or fintech operations

WHAT WE OFFER

- Challenges that will help you grow and realize your potential fast

- Opportunity to make a big impact - you will build innovative services used by millions of investors to build wealth

- Challenging projects with high impact on our international growth

- Collaboration with a team of smart, driven, and supportive high-performers

- A flexible, idea-friendly culture that values ownership and initiative

- Competitive Remuneration package

- Centrally-located office

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

We thank all applicants, but only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. All personal data of applicants is protected by law and treated with strict confidentiality.
